sources.title: Self-Trained Models | Interactive Visual Comparison of Upscaling Models
sources.snippet: Self-Trained Models Intro After creating this webpage, gathering 600+ model files and using them to create the examples here, I turned my attention towards learning how to train my own upscaling models. Since then I have trained some models myself, and on this page I have examples so these models can be compared.
